remaining_gap.explanation: Length/exercise filters do not close the gap. EduData ktbd sequences are not raw per-user streams: they apply session/problem-log construction that raises consecutive repeats (sticky within-session practice). Timed npz is chronological user streams (capped extract). Do not treat the two shares as the same estimand; cite ktbd for ranking eval and timed only for Δt/forgetting.
